verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an official CLI installed via `npm install -g ultrametric`. It is built for agent use: `--json` output with a versioned stdout/stderr schema, non-interactive completion, `init --dry-run` to write skill files for Codex and Claude Code, `context get` for resuming work, `doctor` diagnostics, and an environment flag. A probe independently confirms the CLI install docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented (the 0.4.1 version suggests an early-stage tool).
